title: The Dungeon of Doom tries to destroy Hulkamania
summary: Kevin Sullivan assembles monsters and allies to overwhelm Hogan. The Giant becomes the centerpiece, while Jimmy Hart’s loyalty proves less secure than Hogan expects.

chapters.title: Hogan’s team wins WarGames
chapters.result: Hogan, Sting, Luger and Savage defeat the Dungeon of Doom.
chapters.context: Winning the cage battle does not eliminate the threat posed by the Giant and Sullivan.

chapters.title: Jimmy Hart betrays Hogan
chapters.result: The Giant wins by disqualification after Hart strikes the referee.
chapters.context: A contract clause awards the title to the Giant, before WCW later vacates it. The rooftop monster-truck incident is part of the fictional presentation.
